Author: KeydenK
Name: Giddy Up
Punchline: Mounting, dismounting, Sprint and Peloton done for you, at the right moment.
Description: Giddy Up handles your mount and your running speed so you don't have to: it mounts you up after a zone change, a fight, gathering, crafting or a conversation (waiting until you're done: motifs, heals and buffs first); gets you off the mount when you use an action or when the enemy you target comes into your attack range (landing first if you're flying); uses Sprint when it helps and keeps Peloton up on jobs that have it. Everything is timed from your own measured speeds. Works great with Beeline. Command: /giddyup
